// diagnostic

E0405

`??` fallback type/`return` mismatch

What

`??` fallback type/`return` mismatch

Why

The `??` fallback stands in for the missing value, so it must have the same type, or leave the function

Fix

Make the fallback type match the return type and fallible value.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0405: Tests/UI/bare_return_needs_value.stderr.

Error [jet.FallbackTypeMismatch]: `?? return` here needs a value
  --> Tests/UI/bare_return_needs_value.jet:2:24
    |
  2 |     x := xs.first() ?? return
    |                        ^^^^^^
 Why: A bare `return` needs a value here because the function returns Int
 Fix: Give a fallback value: `?? return <value>`
